data.narrative:
Flapping Airplanes is a private AI & Software company at an undisclosed stage, founded by Benjamin Spector, Asher Spector, and Aidan Smith. The comparable universe consists of 1 public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private peers including Waymo, Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI, drawn from the AI & Software sector.

The peer-median method was not applicable to this valuation. The sector contains 16 total peers in AI & Software, but filtering by stage, adjacent-stage proximity, or valuation tier yielded fewer than three datapoints in any narrow cohort. A median calculated across all 16 same-sector companies would conflate materially different risk profiles and business models, introducing substantial noise rather than signal. Consequently, no triangulated valuation range can be supported from the available comparable data.

The analysis is constrained by sparse, stage-appropriate peer coverage within this frontier-tech segment. The identified private comparables span autonomous systems, synthetic data platforms, and AI infrastructure—vertically diverse businesses that may not anchor meaningful multiples or revenue multiples for Flapping Airplanes without additional context on the target's business model, revenue, and growth trajectory. Further valuation work would require either narrower peer identification, entry of financial metrics (revenue, growth rate, burn), or an alternative approach such as cost-of-capital or DCF modeling using disclosed or estimated cash-flow assumptions.
